lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: Seed sacks have gone missing. I would welcome a quiet pair of eyes at the granary. Quiet, mind. Hungry people do not need another accusation.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

options.label: We will look into the missing grain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: The stores must last the winter. That is my responsibility. If you find a cut sack, follow the grain, not the rumours.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: You know what I kept from the town. I cannot put that right with another speech. Find where those seed sacks went; I will see that this account is answered.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

options.label: We will follow the missing sacks.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: Start with the seed sacks beside the granary. The Ash Market keeps a tally of everything it carries.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: The seed stores, then the market tally. Bring me something I can act on, and I will pay for your trouble.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: A market mark on town seed. I had hoped for a simpler answer. Will you leave the account with me, or take it to Lady Marrowby?
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

options.label: Settle this quietly. Return the grain to the town.
We will speak to Celandine ourselves.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: I will have the sacks counted in daylight, with witnesses. Your payment comes from my purse. Let us begin with that much honesty.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: Then take the tally. She respects a written account, even when she dislikes the sum.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: The seed has been counted. This time the town saw the count. Thank you.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: Keep warm. We have work enough for tomorrow.
lines.direction: Measured, respectable civic baritone; warm by habit, tired pauses; never an oily villain.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: The docks went cold the night you brought it up. If that thing kept Emberwick warm, I need to know what we do now.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: The bridge is open. The road is open. I ought to be relieved, and I keep seeing her on the planks.

lines.speaker: halden_varrow
lines.text: Goblins at the gate and not one of them dead. The council is furious. I have never slept better.
